description: Independent test of which RNA-contacting position is the Pagano discriminator: find positions invariant across non-nematode metazoan TZF proteins but variable across nematode TZF proteins
code:
# ============================================================================
# Iteration 2, analysis 2
# The full text of PMID 17264081 is not open access, so the identity of the
# "discriminator residue" is not readable directly. The abstract gives a
# testable signature: the residue "is variable in nematode TZF proteins, but
# is invariant in other metazoans".
#
# Test: across the 30 RNA-contacting positions defined from PDB 1RGO, find
# every position that is (i) invariant in a set of non-nematode metazoan TZF
# proteins and (ii) variable in a set of nematode TZF proteins. If exactly one
# position satisfies this, the discriminator is identified without the paper.
# ============================================================================
import re, collections
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

OFFSETS = [("C1",-6),("C1",-4),("C1",-3),("C1",-2),("C1",-1),("C1",0),("C1",1),("C1",2),
           ("C2",0),("C2",1),("C2",2),("C3",-1),("C3",0),("C3",1),("C3",2)]
AI = {"C1":0,"C2":1,"C3":2,"H":3}
T_ZF1 = {("C1",-6):153,("C1",-4):155,("C1",-3):156,("C1",-2):157,("C1",-1):158,("C1",0):159,
         ("C1",1):160,("C1",2):161,("C2",0):168,("C2",1):169,("C2",2):170,("C3",-1):173,
         ("C3",0):174,("C3",1):175,("C3",2):176}

ZF_RE = re.compile(r"(?=(C.{7,12}C.{4,6}C.{2,4}H))")
def find_fingers(seq):
    out = {}
    for m in ZF_RE.finditer(seq):
        inner = re.match(r"C(.{7,12}?)C(.{4,6}?)C(.{2,4}?)H$", m.group(1))
        if not inner: continue
        s = m.start() + 1
        l1, l2, l3 = (len(g) for g in inner.groups())
        out.setdefault(s, (s, s+1+l1, s+2+l1+l2, s+3+l1+l2+l3))
    return sorted(out.values())

def up_search(query, size=200):
    """Stream a UniProt search as FASTA."""
    r = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
                     params={"query": query, "format": "fasta", "size": size}, timeout=180)
    r.raise_for_status()
    seqs, name = {}, None
    for line in r.text.split("\n"):
        if line.startswith(">"):
            name = line.split("|")[1] if "|" in line else line[1:20]
            seqs[name] = ""
        elif name:
            seqs[name] += line.strip()
    return seqs

# -- set 1: non-nematode metazoan TTP/TIS11 family (reviewed entries only) ----
meta_raw = up_search("(gene:ZFP36 OR gene:ZFP36L1 OR gene:ZFP36L2 OR gene:ZFP36L3 OR gene:Tis11) "
                     "AND reviewed:true AND taxonomy_id:33208 NOT taxonomy_id:6231")
# -- set 2: nematode CCCH zinc finger proteins (InterPro zf-CCCH, C. elegans) -
nem_raw = up_search("taxonomy_id:6231 AND xref:interpro-IPR000571", size=400)
print("fetched:", len(meta_raw), "metazoan entries,", len(nem_raw), "nematode CCCH entries")

def tzf_set(raw, label):
    """Keep entries with two CCCH fingers separated by a TTP-like linker."""
    keep = {}
    for acc, s in raw.items():
        f = find_fingers(s)
        for i in range(len(f) - 1):
            linker = f[i+1][0] - f[i][3] - 1
            if 14 <= linker <= 30:
                keep[acc] = (s, f[i], f[i+1], linker)
                break
    print(f"{label}: {len(keep)} of {len(raw)} have a tandem CCCH pair with a 14-30 aa linker")
    return keep

META = tzf_set(meta_raw, "metazoan TTP family")
NEM = tzf_set(nem_raw, "nematode CCCH")
assert len(META) >= 8 and len(NEM) >= 8, (len(META), len(NEM))

def read_positions(keep):
    rows = {}
    for acc, (s, f1, f2, lk) in keep.items():
        col = []
        ok = True
        for fi, f in enumerate((f1, f2)):
            for off in OFFSETS:
                p = f[AI[off[0]]] + off[1]
                if p < 1 or p > len(s): ok = False; break
                col.append(s[p-1])
            if not ok: break
        if ok: rows[acc] = col
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

Mdf, Ndf = read_positions(META), read_positions(NEM)
labels = [f"ZF{fi+1} {o[0]}{o[1]:+d}" for fi in (0,1) for o in OFFSETS]
tis = [T_ZF1[o] + 38*fi for fi in (0,1) for o in OFFSETS]
print(f"usable: {Mdf.shape[1]} metazoan, {Ndf.shape[1]} nematode sequences")

res = []
for i, lab in enumerate(labels):
    mv = Mdf.iloc[i].value_counts(); nv = Ndf.iloc[i].value_counts()
    # "invariant" allows for one-off sequencing/annotation oddities: >=95% one residue
    m_major = mv.iloc[0] / mv.sum(); n_major = nv.iloc[0] / nv.sum()
    res.append({"position": lab, "TIS11d_num": tis[i],
                "metazoan_n_aa": len(mv), "metazoan_major": f"{mv.index[0]} {100*m_major:.0f}%",
                "nematode_n_aa": len(nv), "nematode_major": f"{nv.index[0]} {100*n_major:.0f}%",
                "m_major_frac": m_major, "n_major_frac": n_major,
                "metazoan_invariant": m_major >= 0.95,
                "nematode_variable": n_major <= 0.70 and len(nv) >= 3,
                "nematode_aas": "".join(sorted(nv.index))})
R = pd.DataFrame(res)
R.to_csv("discriminator_signature_scan.csv", index=False)
pd.set_option("display.width", 200)
print(R[["position","TIS11d_num","metazoan_major","metazoan_n_aa","nematode_major",
         "nematode_n_aa","nematode_aas","metazoan_invariant","nematode_variable"]].to_string(index=False))

hit = R[R["metazoan_invariant"] & R["nematode_variable"]]
print("\n=== positions matching 'invariant in other metazoans, variable in nematode TZF proteins' ===")
print(hit[["position","TIS11d_num","metazoan_major","nematode_major","nematode_aas"]].to_string(index=False))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 5))
x = np.arange(len(R))
ax.bar(x - 0.2, R["m_major_frac"], 0.4, color="#2b5d8c", label="metazoan TTP family (non-nematode)")
ax.bar(x + 0.2, R["n_major_frac"], 0.4, color="#d98f3a", label="nematode CCCH tandem-finger proteins")
for i in hit.index:
    ax.annotate("match", (i, 1.03), ha="center", fontsize=9, color="#b03030", fontweight="bold")
ax.axhline(0.95, ls="--", lw=0.8, c="#2b5d8c"); ax.axhline(0.70, ls="--", lw=0.8, c="#d98f3a")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(R["position"], rotation=90, fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel("frequency of the most common residue")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.12)
ax.set_title(f"Conservation at the 30 RNA-contacting TZF positions\n"
             f"{Mdf.shape[1]} metazoan TTP-family and {Ndf.shape[1]} nematode tandem-CCCH sequences; "
             f"dashed lines are the invariant (0.95) and variable (0.70) thresholds")
ax.legend(fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
